title: Fourier coefficient of a permuted Maiorana–McFarland function
statement: Let $\pi$ be a permutation of the $n$-dimensional binary cube, let $g$ assign a sign to each point of that cube, and let $a,b$ be points of the cube. The vector Fourier coefficient of the permuted Maiorana–McFarland function at the concatenation of $a$ and $b$ is $2^{-n}$ times the real value of the sign assigned by $g$ to $\pi^{-1}(a)$, multiplied by the Walsh character indexed by $b$ evaluated at $\pi^{-1}(a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a permutation of the $n$-dimensional binary cube
$g$ maps the cube to the sign group
$a,b$ are points of the $n$-dimensional binary cube
